topic: Coral reefs support a quarter of ocean life
script: Coral reefs cover less than 1 percent of the ocean floor. Yet they are home to roughly a quarter of all known marine species. Corals are animals, related to jellyfish and sea anemones. Many get their bright colors and much of their food from tiny algae living inside them. When the water gets too hot, corals push out the algae and turn white, which is called bleaching.
